svg.title: Antenatal care from first suspicion to term: what to assess, test and act on at each stage (confirm and date, first visit, second trimester, third trimester), then how the first-visit group and screen splits into Rh negative without an antibody (Rh immunoglobulin) and an antibody found (titre, middle cerebral artery Doppler, timing of delivery); panels on teratogens (timing, physical, infectious, maternal), drug risk categories and counselling, and who cares for her

svg.text: • A: controlled HUMAN studies, no risk · doxylamine-pyridoxine, folic acid,
